items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: they shouldn't do what they're doing with Glenn Miller's music.

ctx.x: Yeah. It's interesting, Mercer trying to keep that band together. It sounds less and less Ellington as the time goes on, and yet, how else could you be? But it's like -- it's not going to be an Ellington band very long.
Well, they shouldn't do what they're doing with Glenn Miller's music. Ellington's a great composer.
